CONFIRM — no contradiction introduced by the synthesis.

The dependency is exact: accepted D2 V8 plus accepted B0-C specification and exact provider-free oracle identity gate C1-T; C1-T binds every relevant oracle case into the constructor/refusal/mutation/platform matrix; P1 plus aggregate B0 plus accepted C1-T gate production C1-A. C1-C is explicitly required to pass the exact B0-C timestamp/mapping oracle on JVM, JS and Native, and aggregate C1 cannot close without that evidence. D0 remains the first exact source reader. This matches the accepted amendment without moving source access, runtime realization, or D1 integration into C1.
